Damn near psychopathic, without accounting for the Cyberware.

Born to a mother and a father in a house not too expensive or cheap, [INSERT NAME] lived on a quiet street, although it would get rowdy sometimes.

Ganggoons appeared sometimes, but Father would manage to fend them off. Most of the time corporate security was good enough to take care of them.

Followed an Education, then graduated with a good grade.
Became a B-list actor used for body doubles in high-risk scenarios.

Worked as a BD actor thanks to his ability to mimic intense emotions very well.
Was hired by [COMPANY] a few years back for Special Operations.
